name: Bottom Navigation
structurePatterns: horizontal flex container, each destination is a vertical flex (icon over label)
3 to 5 destinations distributed with equal width
count badge shows 1-99, then 99+; dot badge for unread without count
container has a top hairline divider; platform safe area is owned by the platform layer
usageHints: Brand (Electric Indigo) is the active identity; Accent Cyan is reserved for local emphasis
labels stay visible and single-line in V1
badge must not obscure the icon silhouette
56px is the content band excluding safe area
doNotInvent: no floating pill navigation as the V1 default
no default shadow (hairline divider is the boundary)
unknowns: haptic/animation selection timing defined by motion contract, not visualized here
interactionContract: represents direct navigation among 3–5 stable top-level destinations only
active destination is authoritative navigation state and is separate from pressed/transient feedback
deep or numerous destinations move to Drawer/Sheet multi-level navigation rather than expanding Bottom Navigation hierarchy
keyboardContract: when keyboard input is available, every destination remains reachable in semantic destination order
focus-visible treatment follows T012 input policy
accessibilityContract: active destination exposes current-page/current-destination semantics without relying on color alone
every icon has a visible label in the default Bottom Navigation presentation
badges supplement rather than replace destination labels

platformPresentationRefs.note: Preferred for 3–5 stable top-level destinations; not a generic deep-navigation container.
